project.name: Stellar
project.description: A Next.js application in an npm workspace rooted at apps/web.

toolchain.notes: Use a Node release supported by Next.js 16 and the repository toolchain; CI pins Node 22.

commands.devNotes: Run from the repository root; the root script starts apps/web.

verify.notes: Tests include contracts, source preservation, real Astro runner/recovery, operator broker, fixture and harness checks. Build includes the independent Astro fixture. Run npm run fixture:install after npm ci, then npm run verify:local after the production build for real authenticated app-to-runner acceptance. Convex platform schema and offline authorization tests are committed; live provider setup/deployment and dependency audit verification remain unconfigured. The opt-in npm run verify:connected exercises real connected components, backend functions and source with synthetic identity; it does not prove live provider acceptance. Browser editor acceptance runs with npm run verify:editor after build and Playwright Chromium installation; it produces local screenshots, video, source changes and an independent edited-site build.

branches.mergeStrategyNotes: Feature branches target main. No separate production branch or deployment has been configured.

designSystem.tokenVocabulary: Hand-authored foundation and semantic CSS custom properties; follow existing names before adding tokens.
designSystem.notes: The CSS file is both token source and shipped stylesheet. Edit it directly and review affected screens.

jobs.name: Verify
jobs.notes: Matches the locally defined job display name. Remote runs and required branch rules have not been verified.

doesNotCatch: Live deployment behavior; no deployment is configured.
